{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*4 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (24–32 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken#Breast|chicken breasts]]
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] garlic-flavored [[Cookbook:Crouton|croutons]], finely crushed
*¼ cup Italian seasoned [[Cookbook:Breadcrumbs|breadcrumbs]]
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*[[Cookbook:Canola Oil|Canola oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Italian Seasoning|Italian seasoning]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
*2 tbsp [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]], beaten

== Procedure ==
#Combine flour and seasonings in a [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie plate]]. Combine croutons and breadcrumbs in another pie plate, and place the eggs in another pie plate.
#[[Cookbook:Dredging|Dredge]] chicken in flour then dip into eggs. Dredge in crouton mixture and let rest 2–3 minutes.
#Coat chicken with canola oil and place onto a greased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|sheet pan]]. Insert a probe [[Cookbook:Thermometer|thermometer]] into one of the pieces.
#[[Cookbook:Bake|Bake]] in a 425°F [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Serve warm.
